title: Multicellular bioelectric simulator
summary: A work-in-progress learning simulator for passive membrane voltage spreading through a chain of gap-junction-coupled cells.
problem: I am exploring how a small computational model can make a research description of multicellular bioelectric interactions easier to reason about.
accomplishments: Implemented a passive coupled-cell model in Python and NumPy with Euler and fourth-order Runge-Kutta integration.
Added plots and internal tests for current balance, stimulus boundaries, and time-step behavior; scientific validation remains outside this scope.
stakeholders: Readers exploring computational models of cell interactions
currentStatus: A learning project in progress; no reproduction or validation of the cited paper's results is claimed.
publicationBoundary: This project is an independent learning exercise and must not be presented as validated research or as a reproduction of the cited paper.
limitations: No documented comparison with the paper's published results is available.
No validated or reproduced scientific result is claimed.
The current model is limited to passive membrane and gap-junction dynamics; ion-channel behavior, gene expression, cell mechanics, and morphogenesis are outside its scope.
claimPolicy: Describe this as a work-in-progress learning project only.
Do not claim that it reproduces, validates, or confirms the cited paper.
Any future result claim requires a documented comparison and clear limitations.
evidence: The public repository implements a passive cell network in Python with NumPy, plus Euler and fourth-order Runge-Kutta integration.
The test suite checks passive-cell behavior, pairwise gap-current symmetry, stimulus boundaries, and time-step endpoints; these internal checks do not compare results with the cited paper.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: The executable learning model represents a chain of cells as passive electrical membranes coupled by gap junctions. It applies a current pulse and visualizes how membrane voltage changes and spreads over time. It does not simulate gene expression or protein transcription.

sections.heading: Research reference and limits
paragraphs: The project is informed by the cited paper but is not presented as a reproduction of its simulations or findings. No documented comparison, validated output, or reproduced result is claimed.

linkFallback: The public repository is linked above; no interactive demo is available.
